effects.name: Handheld · Light
effects.desc: Subtle, smooth handheld drift for 10 s (loopable feel). Great on static talking-head or screen footage. Trim/extend: keyframes stop at clip end.

effects.name: Micro Jitter
effects.desc: Barely-there high-frequency jitter (10 s) that makes locked-off shots feel alive.

effects.name: Heavy Impact
effects.desc: 20-frame violent hit that decays to rest, with motion blur on the first frames. Put the clip start on the impact / beat drop.

effects.name: Earthquake
effects.desc: 3 s of strong rumbling shake that slowly calms down, with light blur.

effects.name: Rotational
effects.desc: Rocking rotational shake (30 frames, decaying) – feels like a punch to the camera.

effects.name: Walking Bounce
effects.desc: Vertical bob of a walking camera operator (10 s loop).

effects.name: Punch-In 115%
effects.desc: Snaps to 115% in 3 frames and holds – the classic jump-cut cover.

effects.name: Punch In-Out (Beat)
effects.desc: Zooms to 120% on frame 2 and settles back by frame 10. Drop one on every beat.

effects.name: Boom Zoom
effects.desc: Explosive 135% zoom with elastic settle at 112% (18 frames) – 'boom' moments.

effects.name: Zoom Bounce
effects.desc: Zooms from 100% to 125% with a bouncy landing (20 frames).

effects.name: Slow Push-In (5 s)
effects.desc: Ken Burns style 100→112% push over 5 s (use the composition version to fit any length).

effects.name: Slow Pull-Out (5 s)
effects.desc: Ken Burns style 112→100% pull-back over 5 s.

effects.name: Zoom to Top-Left (Screen Rec)
effects.desc: Smooth 15-frame zoom to 180% on the top-left of a screen recording, then holds. Razor the clip where you want to zoom; move the rectangle in the monitor to aim at the cursor.
effects.display: OuzFX Screen Zoom · Zoom to Top-Left (Screen Rec)

effects.name: Zoom to Top-Right (Screen Rec)
effects.desc: Smooth 15-frame zoom to 180% on the top-right of a screen recording, then holds. Razor the clip where you want to zoom; move the rectangle in the monitor to aim at the cursor.
effects.display: OuzFX Screen Zoom · Zoom to Top-Right (Screen Rec)

effects.name: Zoom to Bottom-Left (Screen Rec)
effects.desc: Smooth 15-frame zoom to 180% on the bottom-left of a screen recording, then holds. Razor the clip where you want to zoom; move the rectangle in the monitor to aim at the cursor.
effects.display: OuzFX Screen Zoom · Zoom to Bottom-Left (Screen Rec)

effects.name: Zoom to Bottom-Right (Screen Rec)
effects.desc: Smooth 15-frame zoom to 180% on the bottom-right of a screen recording, then holds. Razor the clip where you want to zoom; move the rectangle in the monitor to aim at the cursor.
effects.display: OuzFX Screen Zoom · Zoom to Bottom-Right (Screen Rec)

effects.name: Zoom to Center (Screen Rec)
effects.desc: Smooth 15-frame zoom to 180% on the center of a screen recording, then holds. Razor the clip where you want to zoom; move the rectangle in the monitor to aim at the cursor.
effects.display: OuzFX Screen Zoom · Zoom to Center (Screen Rec)

effects.name: Zoom Back Out (Screen Rec)
effects.desc: Companion to the screen zooms: from 180% (center) back to full frame in 15 frames.
effects.display: OuzFX Screen Zoom · Zoom Back Out (Screen Rec)

effects.name: Pop-In
effects.desc: Scales from 0 to 100% with a back-overshoot in 12 frames.

effects.name: Slide In from Left
effects.desc: Slides in from the left edge in 12 frames (expo ease-out) with directional motion blur.
effects.display: OuzFX Anim · Slide In from Left

effects.name: Slide In from Right
effects.desc: Slides in from the right edge in 12 frames (expo ease-out) with directional motion blur.
effects.display: OuzFX Anim · Slide In from Right

effects.name: Slide In from Top
effects.desc: Slides in from the top edge in 12 frames (expo ease-out) with directional motion blur.
effects.display: OuzFX Anim · Slide In from Top

effects.name: Slide In from Bottom
effects.desc: Slides in from the bottom edge in 12 frames (expo ease-out) with directional motion blur.
effects.display: OuzFX Anim · Slide In from Bottom

effects.name: Bounce In (Drop)
effects.desc: Drops from above and bounces on the floor (20 frames).

effects.name: Spin-In
effects.desc: Spins 360° while scaling from 0 to 100% (15 frames, cubic ease-out).

effects.name: Fade + Scale In
effects.desc: Gentle 92→100% scale with fade-in over 15 frames – clean Apple-style reveal.

effects.name: Whip-In
effects.desc: Very fast slide from the right with heavy motion blur (6 frames).

effects.name: Elastic Zoom-In
effects.desc: Springs in from 40% to 100% with an elastic wobble (20 frames).

effects.name: Blur-In
effects.desc: Starts heavily blurred and transparent, resolves to sharp in 15 frames.

effects.name: Tilt Left
effects.desc: Screen recording turned into a 3D panel facing left: rounded corners, perspective and a soft drop shadow. Put a background on the track below.

effects.name: Tilt Right
effects.desc: Mirror of Tilt Left – panel facing right.

effects.name: Laptop Lean
effects.desc: Panel leaning back like a laptop screen seen from the desk.

effects.name: Floating Screen (Flat)
effects.desc: Flat floating window: rounded corners, 82% scale, big soft shadow.

effects.name: Swing to Front
effects.desc: Starts tilted left and swings to a flat, centred panel in 25 frames – nice opener for a demo.

effects.name: Floating Screen · Pop In
effects.desc: Floating window pops in from 40% with overshoot (18 frames), rounded + shadow.
effects.display: OuzFX Screen 3D · Floating Screen · Pop In

effects.name: RGB Split Hit
effects.desc: 8-frame chromatic split that kicks hard and snaps back – sync to a beat or a cut.

effects.name: Digital Glitch Burst
effects.desc: 12 frames of block glitching + RGB tearing that fades out.

effects.name: VHS Tape
effects.desc: Scanlines, chroma bleed, soft blur, noise and slightly washed colour – instant 90s tape.

effects.name: Flash Frame (White)
effects.desc: 2-frame white flash that fades by frame 6 – hides a cut and adds punch.

effects.name: Dip Flash (Black)
effects.desc: Quick dip to black and back in 6 frames.

effects.name: Film Burn Flash
effects.desc: Warm orange over-exposure with glow that peaks at frame 6 and clears by 16.

effects.name: Warm Light Leak Look
effects.desc: Soft warm glow and lifted highlights (static look). For moving leaks, also drop overlays/ouzfx_light_leak.mp4 on a track above with Screen blend.
effects.display: OuzFX Stylize · Warm Light Leak Look

effects.name: Red Moment
effects.desc: MrBeast-style 'stress' tint: flash to deep red with a small punch (hold 1–2 s).

effects.name: B&W Flashback
effects.desc: Black & white, grain, vignette and old-film flicker for flashbacks / archive footage.

effects.name: Cinematic 2.39:1 Bars + Vignette
effects.desc: Letterbox bars for a 2.39:1 look plus a soft vignette.

effects.name: Cinematic Bars Slide-In
effects.desc: 2.39:1 letterbox bars glide in over 15 frames – 'movie moment' / dramatic beat.

effects.name: Film Grain + Dust
effects.desc: Organic grain with a few dust specks – makes digital footage feel shot on film.

effects.name: Soft Vignette
effects.desc: Gentle edge darkening that pulls the eye to the centre.

effects.name: Impact Hit (Shake + Flash + Zoom)
effects.desc: All-in-one hit: 2-frame flash, 125% punch and a decaying shake (12 frames). Use on beat drops.
effects.display: OuzFX Fast · Impact Hit (Shake + Flash + Zoom)

effects.name: Smash Cut In
effects.desc: Starts at 140% with blur and slams to 100% in 4 frames – energetic hard cut entry.

effects.name: Zoom Cut (Hard 130%)
effects.desc: Instant 130% reframe, no animation – the MrBeast wide→close 'zoom cut'.

effects.name: Beat Pulse ×4
effects.desc: Four quick 108% pulses, one every 12 frames (≈120 BPM at 24 fps). Stretch keyframes to your tempo.

effects.name: Stutter Strobe
effects.desc: 6-frame on/off brightness strobe – for glitchy, aggressive moments.

effects.name: Freeze-Frame Pop
effects.desc: Pair with Kdenlive's freeze (Timeline ▸ Insert Freeze Frame / Freeze effect): saturation boost, slight zoom and white flash so the still frame 'pops'.

effects.name: Motion-Blur Push Left
effects.desc: Last 6 frames of a clip: whips the picture out to the left with heavy blur. Pair with 'Whip-In' on the next clip.

effects.name: Rush Zoom
effects.desc: Accelerating zoom (100→160%) with growing blur over 8 frames – cut on the last frame.

effects.name: Text Pop
effects.desc: For title clips: pops in with a back overshoot in 8 frames (kinetic typography staple).

effects.name: Text Slam
effects.desc: Title slams down from 300% and the frame shakes on landing (14 frames).

effects.name: Text Rise
effects.desc: Rises 6% and fades in over 12 frames – clean lower-third / callout entry.

effects.name: Text Wiggle (Loop)
effects.desc: Playful ±3° wiggle and 2% breathe for 4 s – for stickers, arrows, emojis.

effects.name: Highlight Flash
effects.desc: Draws attention to a callout: brightness flash + 110% pulse (10 frames).

effects.name: Overshoot_Slide_In_Left
effects.desc: Slides in from the left edge, overshoots its resting spot by ~8% and settles back (14 frames, back ease-out) with a short motion-blur peak.

effects.name: Overshoot_Slide_In_Right
effects.desc: Slides in from the right edge, overshoots its resting spot by ~8% and settles back (14 frames, back ease-out) with a short motion-blur peak.

effects.name: Overshoot_Slide_In_Top
effects.desc: Slides in from the top edge, overshoots its resting spot by ~8% and settles back (14 frames, back ease-out) with a short motion-blur peak.

effects.name: Overshoot_Slide_In_Bottom
effects.desc: Slides in from the bottom edge, overshoots its resting spot by ~8% and settles back (14 frames, back ease-out) with a short motion-blur peak.

effects.name: Masked_Edge_Reveal_Up
effects.desc: Emerges up out of an invisible line through the middle of the frame: the layer slides while a static crop keeps only the upper half visible (15 frames, expo ease-out). Made for split graphics / callout cards – move the Crop rectangle to put the line anywhere.

effects.name: Masked_Edge_Reveal_Down
effects.desc: Emerges down out of an invisible line through the middle of the frame: the layer slides while a static crop keeps only the lower half visible (15 frames, expo ease-out). Made for split graphics / callout cards – move the Crop rectangle to put the line anywhere.

effects.name: Masked_Edge_Reveal_Left
effects.desc: Emerges left out of an invisible line through the middle of the frame: the layer slides while a static crop keeps only the left half visible (15 frames, expo ease-out). Made for split graphics / callout cards – move the Crop rectangle to put the line anywhere.

effects.name: Masked_Edge_Reveal_Right
effects.desc: Emerges right out of an invisible line through the middle of the frame: the layer slides while a static crop keeps only the right half visible (15 frames, expo ease-out). Made for split graphics / callout cards – move the Crop rectangle to put the line anywhere.

effects.name: Idle_Float_Gentle
effects.desc: Continuous hover for static PNGs/screenshots: ±1% vertical bob with ±1.2° sway (sine, 200 frames ≈ 8 s, loops seamlessly – extend by copying keyframes).

effects.name: Idle_Float_Strong
effects.desc: Continuous hover for static PNGs/screenshots: ±2% vertical bob with ±2° sway (sine, 160 frames ≈ 6.4 s, loops seamlessly – extend by copying keyframes).

effects.name: Card_3D_Swing_In_Left
effects.desc: Tweet / document / card swings in from the left in 3D perspective and flattens to face the viewer (18 frames, cubic ease-out). Uses the Corners effect; works without Drop Shadow (any 24.08+).

effects.name: Card_3D_Swing_In_Right
effects.desc: Tweet / document / card swings in from the right in 3D perspective and flattens to face the viewer (18 frames, cubic ease-out). Uses the Corners effect; works without Drop Shadow (any 24.08+).

effects.name: Hinge_Swing_In_Top_Left
effects.desc: Swings down into frame around its top-left corner like a sign on a hinge, then settles with a small decaying swing (24 frames).

effects.name: Hinge_Swing_In_Top_Right
effects.desc: Mirror of Hinge Swing-In Top-Left – pivots around the top-right corner.

effects.name: Pendulum_Swing_Settle
effects.desc: Hangs from the top-centre and swings like a pendulum (±25°, decaying over 36 frames) – hanging signs, price tags, name cards.

effects.name: PiP_Snap_Top_Left
effects.desc: Shrinks a full-screen clip to a 32% picture-in-picture and snaps it into the top-left corner with rounded edges (12 frames, cubic ease-out). For a border/shadow add 'OuzFX AFX_Util_Drop_Shadow_Polish' after it.

effects.name: PiP_Snap_Top_Right
effects.desc: Shrinks a full-screen clip to a 32% picture-in-picture and snaps it into the top-right corner with rounded edges (12 frames, cubic ease-out). For a border/shadow add 'OuzFX AFX_Util_Drop_Shadow_Polish' after it.

effects.name: PiP_Snap_Bottom_Left
effects.desc: Shrinks a full-screen clip to a 32% picture-in-picture and snaps it into the bottom-left corner with rounded edges (12 frames, cubic ease-out). For a border/shadow add 'OuzFX AFX_Util_Drop_Shadow_Polish' after it.

effects.name: PiP_Snap_Bottom_Right
effects.desc: Shrinks a full-screen clip to a 32% picture-in-picture and snaps it into the bottom-right corner with rounded edges (12 frames, cubic ease-out). For a border/shadow add 'OuzFX AFX_Util_Drop_Shadow_Polish' after it.

effects.name: Text_Word_Pop_Shorts
effects.desc: TikTok/Reels/Shorts caption pop: 85% → 105% → 100% in 4 frames. Faster and subtler than 'Text · Text Pop' – drop it on every caption clip.

effects.name: Text_Typewriter_Wipe_Fast
effects.desc: Linear left-to-right crop reveal that uncovers a line of text over 25 frames (1 s @25 fps). Put it on a title clip; drag the last keyframe to change the speed.

effects.name: Text_Typewriter_Wipe_Slow
effects.desc: Linear left-to-right crop reveal that uncovers a line of text over 50 frames (2 s @25 fps). Put it on a title clip; drag the last keyframe to change the speed.

effects.name: Text_Glitch_In
effects.desc: Title flickers on: erratic opacity drops, tiny horizontal jitter and RGB tearing over the first 6 frames, then locks steady.

effects.name: Impact_Shake_Light
effects.desc: Light decaying X/Y + rotational jitter (10 frames) for bass hits, desk slams and small impacts. Heavy tier = 'Shake · Heavy Impact'.

effects.name: Impact_Shake_Medium
effects.desc: Medium decaying X/Y + rotational jitter (15 frames) for bass hits, desk slams and small impacts. Heavy tier = 'Shake · Heavy Impact'.

effects.name: Whip_Pan_Push_Right
effects.desc: Last 8 frames of a clip: whips the picture out right with heavy directional blur. Razor 8 frames before the cut and drop it on the right-hand piece (left version = 'Fast · Motion-Blur Push Left').

effects.name: Whip_Pan_Push_Up
effects.desc: Last 8 frames of a clip: whips the picture out up with heavy directional blur. Razor 8 frames before the cut and drop it on the right-hand piece (left version = 'Fast · Motion-Blur Push Left').

effects.name: Whip_Pan_Push_Down
effects.desc: Last 8 frames of a clip: whips the picture out down with heavy directional blur. Razor 8 frames before the cut and drop it on the right-hand piece (left version = 'Fast · Motion-Blur Push Left').

effects.name: Heartbeat_Pulse
effects.desc: Two 'lub-dub' heartbeats (≈ 70 BPM, 72 frames): a small 103.5% swell, a bigger 105% one, with a matching darkening throb. Builds tension; copy keyframes to extend.

effects.name: Dutch_Angle_Subtle_8deg
effects.desc: Eases the horizon to a 8° Dutch angle over 20 frames and holds, auto-zooming just enough (124%) that no black corners show. Suspense / confusion / surreal beats.

effects.name: Dutch_Angle_Strong_15deg
effects.desc: Eases the horizon to a 15° Dutch angle over 20 frames and holds, auto-zooming just enough (143%) that no black corners show. Suspense / confusion / surreal beats.

effects.name: Zoom_Callout_Return_Top_Left
effects.desc: Return half of the callout: from the 180% top-left zoom (Screen Zoom · Zoom to Top-Left) smoothly back to 100% in 15 frames. Razor where the callout ends.

effects.name: Zoom_Callout_Return_Top_Right
effects.desc: Return half of the callout: from the 180% top-right zoom (Screen Zoom · Zoom to Top-Right) smoothly back to 100% in 15 frames. Razor where the callout ends.

effects.name: Zoom_Callout_Return_Bottom_Left
effects.desc: Return half of the callout: from the 180% bottom-left zoom (Screen Zoom · Zoom to Bottom-Left) smoothly back to 100% in 15 frames. Razor where the callout ends.

effects.name: Zoom_Callout_Return_Bottom_Right
effects.desc: Return half of the callout: from the 180% bottom-right zoom (Screen Zoom · Zoom to Bottom-Right) smoothly back to 100% in 15 frames. Razor where the callout ends.

effects.name: Cinematic_Bars_Slide_Out
effects.desc: Out half of the letterbox: 2.39:1 bars retract over 15 frames, leaving 'movie mode'. Pair with 'Look · Cinematic Bars Slide-In'.

effects.name: BG_Dim_Blur_In
effects.desc: Background layer: dims to 55% and blurs over 12 frames so text / overlays on the track above become legible.

effects.name: BG_Dim_Blur_Out
effects.desc: Brings a dimmed + blurred background back to normal over 12 frames (pair with Dim_Blur_In).

effects.name: Spotlight_Focus_In
effects.desc: Animated spotlight: everything outside a soft ellipse darkens to 42% over 15 frames, pulling the eye to the subject. Move/resize the ellipse in the Alpha shapes effect.

effects.name: Spotlight_Focus_Out
effects.desc: Releases the spotlight: the darkened edges brighten back to normal over 15 frames.

effects.name: Highlighter_Wipe
effects.desc: Put it on a yellow Color clip above an article/PDF shot: a 45%-opacity marker band wipes on left-to-right in 12 frames. Move/resize the Transform rectangle over the line you want to highlight.

effects.name: Split_Screen_Left
effects.desc: Crops the centre of the clip and places it in the left half. Put the partner clip on another track with Split_Screen_Right.

effects.name: Split_Screen_Left_Slide_In
effects.desc: Same as Split_Screen_Left, but the half slides in from the left edge (15 frames, cubic ease-out).

effects.name: Split_Screen_Right
effects.desc: Crops the centre of the clip and places it in the right half. Put the partner clip on another track with Split_Screen_Left.

effects.name: Split_Screen_Right_Slide_In
effects.desc: Same as Split_Screen_Right, but the half slides in from the right edge (15 frames, cubic ease-out).

effects.name: Split_Screen_Top
effects.desc: Crops the centre of the clip and places it in the top half. Put the partner clip on another track with Split_Screen_Bottom. Top/Bottom = stacked layout for vertical Shorts/Reels.

effects.name: Split_Screen_Top_Slide_In
effects.desc: Same as Split_Screen_Top, but the half slides in from the top edge (15 frames, cubic ease-out).

effects.name: Split_Screen_Bottom
effects.desc: Crops the centre of the clip and places it in the bottom half. Put the partner clip on another track with Split_Screen_Top. Top/Bottom = stacked layout for vertical Shorts/Reels.

effects.name: Split_Screen_Bottom_Slide_In
effects.desc: Same as Split_Screen_Bottom, but the half slides in from the bottom edge (15 frames, cubic ease-out).

effects.name: Censor_Pixelate_Box
effects.desc: Mosaic-pixelates a rectangle in the middle of the frame. Move/resize/keyframe it in the Alpha shapes effect (Position/Size) to cover faces, usernames or private data.

effects.name: Censor_Blur_Box
effects.desc: Heavy Gaussian blur inside a soft-edged rectangle – a less blocky redaction. Move/resize it in the Alpha shapes effect.

effects.name: Drop_Shadow_Polish
effects.desc: Static two-layer shadow for text / PNG cut-outs: a crisp, slightly offset contact shadow plus a soft ambient one. No keyframes, so it never fights your animation. Needs Kdenlive 25.04+.

effects.name: Record_Scratch_Freeze
effects.desc: Instant high-contrast black & white with a slow 100→110% push over 3 s – the 'yep, that's me' record-scratch moment. Combine with a freeze frame (Timeline ▸ Insert Freeze Frame).

effects.name: Glitch_Flicker
effects.desc: 12 frames of erratic opacity drops with horizontal displacement and light block distortion – a signal-dropout flicker (use on footage over a background).

effects.name: Damage_Pulse_Red
effects.desc: Gaming 'taking damage' / warning: the screen edges pulse red three times (36 frames) while the centre stays clean. Edge ellipse is adjustable in the Alpha shapes effect.

effects.name: Underwater_Muffled
effects.desc: Steep 24 dB/oct low-pass at 450 Hz (two stacked filters) with a little low-end warmth – audio behind a closed door, under water or in the next room.

effects.name: Telephone_Voice
effects.desc: Clean phone line: 400–3200 Hz band-pass (24 dB/oct top), a presence bump and limiter-squash compression.

effects.name: Walkie_Talkie_Radio
effects.desc: Narrow 500–2600 Hz radio band with light bit-crush overdrive and hard limiter compression – walkie-talkie / police radio callouts.

effects.name: Hall_Echo_Reverb
effects.desc: Spacious multi-tap hall echo: three cascaded delays (≈60, 260 and 295 ms → taps up to ~0.6 s) with a safety limiter. Ominous moments, inner monologue, punchlines. Lower the 'wet' values for a subtler room.

effects.name: Voiceover_Quick_Polish
effects.desc: Starter vocal chain: 80 Hz high-pass (mic rumble), gentle loudness leveling towards -18 LUFS (Kdenlive's Dynamic Loudness, ±6 dB) and a -1 dBFS safety limiter.

compositions.name: Zoom-Through In
compositions.desc: Top clip flies in from 300% (transparent) to full frame – put it over the end of the lower clip.

compositions.name: Zoom-Through Out
compositions.desc: Top clip rushes towards the camera (100→300%) and fades, revealing the clip below.

compositions.name: Shrink Away
compositions.desc: Top clip shrinks to nothing in the centre, revealing the lower track.

compositions.name: Whip Pan Left
compositions.desc: Top clip enters from the opposite side and whips left into place with strong ease-out (add a dblur/boxblur for extra smear). Keep it 6–10 frames.

compositions.name: Whip Pan Right
compositions.desc: Top clip enters from the opposite side and whips right into place with strong ease-out (add a dblur/boxblur for extra smear). Keep it 6–10 frames.

compositions.name: Whip Pan Up
compositions.desc: Top clip enters from the opposite side and whips up into place with strong ease-out (add a dblur/boxblur for extra smear). Keep it 6–10 frames.

compositions.name: Whip Pan Down
compositions.desc: Top clip enters from the opposite side and whips down into place with strong ease-out (add a dblur/boxblur for extra smear). Keep it 6–10 frames.

compositions.name: Spin In
compositions.desc: Top clip spins in 360° from 0% – fun, high-energy reveal.

compositions.name: Spin Out
compositions.desc: Top clip spins away 360° shrinking to 0%.

compositions.name: Slide Out Left
compositions.desc: Top clip exits to the left (expo ease-in). Place it over the END of the clip.

compositions.name: Slide Out Right
compositions.desc: Top clip exits to the right (expo ease-in). Place it over the END of the clip.

compositions.name: Slide Out Up
compositions.desc: Top clip exits to the up (expo ease-in). Place it over the END of the clip.

compositions.name: Slide Out Down
compositions.desc: Top clip exits to the down (expo ease-in). Place it over the END of the clip.

compositions.name: Pop Out
compositions.desc: Anticipates (grows to 106%) then collapses to 0% – place over the end of a clip/title.

compositions.name: Fade + Scale Out
compositions.desc: Soft 100→92% shrink with fade-out.

compositions.name: Pop In (Any Length)
compositions.desc: Back-overshoot pop-in that stretches to the composition length.

compositions.name: Ken Burns Push-In (Any Length)
compositions.desc: 100→115% slow push that always spans the whole composition – stretch it over a photo/clip.
compositions.display: OuzFX Zoom · Ken Burns Push-In (Any Length)

compositions.name: Ken Burns Pull-Out (Any Length)
compositions.desc: 115→100% slow pull-back spanning the composition.
compositions.display: OuzFX Zoom · Ken Burns Pull-Out (Any Length)

compositions.name: Ken Burns Pan L→R (Any Length)
compositions.desc: Pans across a 120% image from left to right over the composition length.
compositions.display: OuzFX Zoom · Ken Burns Pan L→R (Any Length)

compositions.name: Picture-in-Picture Corner (Pop)
compositions.desc: Webcam/facecam bubble: pops into the bottom-right corner at 30% size.

compositions.name: Film Burn Wipe
compositions.desc: Wipe composition using the bundled ouzfx_burn.png luma (softness 0.25). The same luma is also selectable in every Wipe/Luma transition and same-track mix.

compositions.name: Glitch Blocks Wipe
compositions.desc: Wipe composition using the bundled ouzfx_glitch_blocks.png luma (softness 0.0). The same luma is also selectable in every Wipe/Luma transition and same-track mix.

compositions.name: Diamond Wipe
compositions.desc: Wipe composition using the bundled ouzfx_diamond.png luma (softness 0.08). The same luma is also selectable in every Wipe/Luma transition and same-track mix.

compositions.name: Clock Wipe
compositions.desc: Wipe composition using the bundled ouzfx_clock.png luma (softness 0.04). The same luma is also selectable in every Wipe/Luma transition and same-track mix.

compositions.name: Iris Wipe
compositions.desc: Wipe composition using the bundled ouzfx_radial.png luma (softness 0.1). The same luma is also selectable in every Wipe/Luma transition and same-track mix.

compositions.name: Ken_Burns_Pan_Right_to_Left
compositions.desc: Pans across a 120% image from right to left over the whole composition length (companion of Pan L→R).

compositions.name: Ken_Burns_Pan_Up
compositions.desc: Tilts up across a 120% image (bottom → top) over the composition length – tall photos, buildings.

compositions.name: Ken_Burns_Pan_Down
compositions.desc: Tilts down across a 120% image (top → bottom) over the composition length.
